name: Gorn Axefist opens the riding trainer window like Hank Dullahan (#7549)
contract: Gorn Axefist (75133) is the Horde 'Riding Trainer' of the Path to Ascension, the counterpart of Hank Dullahan
(776785). A right click shows Hank's page, one option "I seek training to ride a steed.", and that option opens
the riding trainer window, in which Apprentice Riding (33388) is available at level 20.
